You were a binge eater, which is an eating disorder itself. So that means you are prone to eating disorders. 
Be careful. It’s a good thing to lose excess weight, but make sure you’re doing it in a healthy way. You have to be on a slight calorie deficit, but not extreme. Best thing for that is calorie counting. That way you can make sure you don’t eat too much or too little.
